test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 24 Jun 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: A group of men decided to complete a job in 4 days. However, since 10 men dropped out every day, the job got completed at the end of the 7th day. How many men were there in the beginning?
solution:
**Given:**

Days to complete job initially = 4

Actual days taken = 7

Men dropping out each day = 10

**Formula used:**

Total Work = Initial Number of Men × Days × Daily Work Rate

Let Initial Number of Men = x

Total Work = x × 4

**Calculations:**

On Day 1: Men = x, Work done = x

On Day 2: Men = x - 10, Work done = x - 10

On Day 3: Men = x - 20, Work done = x - 20

On Day 4: Men = x - 30, Work done = x - 30

On Day 5: Men = x - 40, Work done = x - 40

On Day 6: Men = x - 50, Work done = x - 50

On Day 7: Men = x - 60, Work done = x - 60

Total Work done = x + (x - 10) + (x - 20) + (x - 30) + (x - 40) + (x - 50) + (x - 60)

⇒ Total Work = 7x - (10 + 20 + 30 + 40 + 50 + 60)

⇒ Total Work = 7x - 210

**Setting the total work equal:**

x × 4 = 7x - 210

⇒ 4x = 7x - 210

⇒ 3x = 210

⇒ x = 70

**∴ Initial Number of Men = 70**
